gbm_population_evidence.quote: Identified as caregiver by patient with glioma as defined as the primary, non-professional, non-paid person who provides the majority of emotional financial and/or physical support.
Has a histologically confirmed malignancy that is a high grade glioma which includes (astrocytoma, oligodendroglioma, glioblastoma, ependymoma).

candidate_evidence.quote: [DEVICE] Cereset Research Wearable: CRW is a stress-relaxation device where participants listen to sounds that help to balance brain rhythms.
[PROCEDURE] Stress management therapy: Undergo Cereset research office intervention

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: caregivers of newly diagnosed high-grade glioma patients

coder_notes: Enrolled participants are caregivers (not patients) of people with high-grade glioma; glioblastoma is named only as one of the care-recipient's eligible tumour types. Coded not_glioblastoma because the trial population does not have glioblastoma; if adjudicators instead read the care-recipient criterion as the population, it would be mixed_glioma_gbm_named. Intervention is an acoustic stimulation device (Cereset) for caregiver stress; no drugs. Phase NA. Treatment setting refers to the care-recipients (newly diagnosed per brief summary; eligibility does not restrict).
